task: perf: ventures-tests runner unit tests idle on FAIL_QUIET
notes: Metric: wall time of `python3 -m unittest test_run_venture_tests` in platform/ci (CI step 'ventures tests / Runner unit tests', 19 runs, 21 s median in ci_profile --runs 300 --steps 30, 2026-11-13 22:13-22:35Z). Before: 19.5, 19.7, 21.9 s local (same container, -W ignore). After: 10.46, 10.45, 10.36 s; 31/31 pass. Cause: test_a_failing_test_that_leaves_a_server_open_fails_fast waited the real FAIL_QUIET=10 s; now patched to 1 s (1.21 s x6). Mutant check: FAILED_LINE made never-matching -> test fails at 20.0 s. Both perf backlog items (P063, P064) owner-gated, so the pool reading picked the step. Local run_workflow_locally --for-changes started (Pages tests triggered by the post); see PR for outcome.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id

certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured
